intro.heading: Celebrity Alaska Cruises
paragraphs: Celebrity Alaska Cruises combine dramatic glaciers, wildlife, scenic waterways and historic Alaska ports with the elevated onboard experience of Celebrity Cruises.

Celebrity's Alaska program includes 7-night glacier itineraries, Inside Passage sailings and one-way routes between Vancouver and Seward, along with selected round-trip cruises from Vancouver and Seattle. Current Celebrity itineraries include glacier-focused journeys featuring destinations such as Hubbard Glacier, Dawes Glacier, Juneau, Skagway, Ketchikan, Sitka and Icy Strait Point.

Celebrity also offers Cruisetours that combine a cruise with multi-night land experiences in Alaska, including destinations such as Denali, Anchorage and Talkeetna. For travelers planning an Alaska cruise, the key decisions are the ship, itinerary, glacier experience, departure port, excursions, sailing season and whether to add a pre- or post-cruise land tour.
intro.quickAnswer: Celebrity Alaska Cruises are seasonal voyages through Alaska and the Inside Passage, combining glacier viewing, wildlife, scenic cruising, Alaska ports and shore excursions with Celebrity's premium onboard experience. Current Celebrity Alaska routes include Northbound Glacier, Southbound Glacier and Dawes or Hubbard Glacier itineraries, with selected sailings operating between Vancouver and Seward or round trip from Vancouver or Seattle.

northboundGlacier.title: Celebrity Alaska Northbound Glacier
northboundGlacier.summary: A Northbound Glacier itinerary typically travels from Vancouver to Seward. Sailing north through the Inside Passage, this route showcases Alaska's premier southeastern ports before reaching the dramatic face of Hubbard Glacier and concluding in Seward. This type of itinerary works particularly well for travelers who want to continue into an Alaska land vacation after the cruise.

southboundGlacier.title: Celebrity Alaska Southbound Glacier
southboundGlacier.summary: A Southbound Glacier itinerary travels from Seward to Vancouver. Beginning in Seward following an optional land tour, the ship sails past Hubbard Glacier and navigates through the Inside Passage to Vancouver. This route is especially useful when beginning with an Alaska land experience and finishing with a relaxing cruise south.
bestFor: Denali or inland Alaska before cruising

hubbardGlacier.title: Celebrity Alaska Hubbard Glacier Cruises
hubbardGlacier.summary: Hubbard Glacier is one of the signature glacier experiences available on selected Celebrity Alaska itineraries. The glacier is located near Yakutat and is known for its immense scale and dramatic ice formations. On a Hubbard Glacier sailing, travelers can view the glacier from the ship while sailing through the surrounding waters. Celebrity describes Hubbard Glacier as the longest tidewater glacier in the world.

dawesGlacier.title: Celebrity Alaska Dawes Glacier Cruises
dawesGlacier.summary: Dawes Glacier is another glacier experience featured on selected Celebrity Alaska itineraries. Located at the head of Endicott Arm Fjord, Dawes Glacier cruises operate round trip from Vancouver and, on selected routes, from Seattle or between Vancouver and Seattle.

insidePassage.title: Celebrity Alaska Inside Passage Cruises
insidePassage.summary: The Inside Passage is one of the defining experiences of an Alaska cruise. The route passes through a network of waterways surrounded by forested islands, snow-covered mountains, glaciers, fjords, and waterfalls. Celebrity's Alaska itineraries include Inside Passage scenic cruising on selected routes.

ports.title: Juneau
ports.subtitle: Alaska's Capital Port
ports.description: Juneau is Alaska's capital and one of the most popular stops on an Alaska cruise. Accessible only by boat or plane, it offers dramatic glaciers, whale watching, hiking trails, scenic tours, and rich gold mining history.
bullets: Celebrity highlights Juneau for hiking and whale-watching

ports.title: Skagway
ports.subtitle: Gateway to the Klondike
ports.description: Skagway is closely connected to Alaska's historic 1898 Gold Rush. Travelers can ride the vintage White Pass & Yukon Route Railway, explore Klondike Gold Rush National Historical Park, and venture into rugged mountain trails.
bullets: Skagway combines rich frontier history with mountain scenery

ports.title: Ketchikan
ports.subtitle: Salmon Capital & Native Heritage
ports.description: Ketchikan is known for its connection to Alaska Native heritage, vibrant salmon fishing, and lush Tongass Rainforest scenery. It boasts the world's largest collection of standing Native American totem poles.
bullets: Celebrity highlights Ketchikan's authentic Native heritage

ports.title: Sitka
ports.subtitle: Russian Heritage & Coastal Islands
ports.description: Sitka offers a unique combination of coastal scenery, Alaska Native Tlingit heritage, and Russian-era colonial history, set beneath picturesque Mount Edgecumbe volcano.
bullets: Otter & seal viewing in Silver Bay
Sitka appears on selected Celebrity Alaska itineraries

ports.title: Icy Strait Point
ports.subtitle: Wilderness & Native Tlingit Culture
ports.description: Icy Strait Point is a privately-owned Native Alaskan destination in Hoonah. It offers exceptional wilderness encounters, premier whale watching in Point Adolphus, and the world's largest ZipRider.
bullets: Icy Strait Point appears on selected glacier itineraries

ports.title: Inside Passage
ports.subtitle: Defining Scenic Cruising
ports.description: The Inside Passage is one of the defining experiences of an Alaska cruise. The ship navigates tranquil coastal channels protected from open ocean swell, bordered by steep mountains and dense rainforest.
bullets: Featured on selected Celebrity Alaska routes

cruisetours.title: Celebrity Alaska Cruisetours
cruisetours.summary: Celebrity Cruisetours combine a seven-night Alaska cruise with a multi-night land tour. This allows travelers to experience both the southeastern coastline and Alaska's rugged interior. Led by dedicated tour directors, these journeys seamlessly blend premium rail travel, wilderness lodges, and national park exploration.

denali.summary: Denali is the most popular addition to a Celebrity Alaska vacation. A Cruisetour combines an Alaska Cruise + Denali National Park + Interior Alaska. Travelers travel aboard the glass-domed Wilderness Express train and stay in mountain lodges near the park entrance.

faqs.question: What are Celebrity Alaska Cruises?
faqs.answer: Celebrity Alaska Cruises are seasonal voyages through Alaska and the Inside Passage featuring glacier viewing, wildlife, Alaska ports, scenic cruising and shore excursions.

faqs.question: What ships does Celebrity use for Alaska cruises?
faqs.answer: Celebrity's Alaska ships vary by sailing and season. Current and recent itineraries include Celebrity Solstice, Celebrity Summit and Celebrity Edge.

faqs.question: When is the Celebrity Alaska cruise season?
faqs.answer: The main Celebrity Alaska cruise season runs from approximately May through September, with June, July and August generally considered the peak months.

faqs.question: What is the best month for a Celebrity Alaska cruise?
faqs.answer: July is one of the most popular months for Alaska cruising. September can appeal to travelers seeking fall scenery, fewer crowds and possible Northern Lights viewing.

faqs.question: Which Alaska ports does Celebrity visit?
faqs.answer: Depending on the itinerary, Celebrity can visit Juneau, Skagway, Ketchikan, Sitka and Icy Strait Point, along with scenic destinations such as Hubbard Glacier and the Inside Passage.

faqs.question: Does Celebrity offer Alaska glacier cruises?
faqs.answer: Yes. Celebrity offers glacier-focused itineraries featuring destinations such as Hubbard Glacier and Dawes Glacier.

faqs.question: Does Celebrity cruise the Inside Passage?
faqs.answer: Yes. Inside Passage scenic cruising is included on selected Celebrity Alaska itineraries.

faqs.question: What are the best Celebrity Alaska shore excursions?
faqs.answer: Popular options include glacier experiences, whale watching, wildlife tours, helicopter excursions, hiking, kayaking, cultural experiences and Gold Rush history tours.

faqs.question: Are Celebrity Alaska excursions included?
faqs.answer: Shore excursions are generally an additional cost on Celebrity Alaska cruises. Travelers can choose excursions based on their sailing and port.

faqs.question: Is a balcony worth it on a Celebrity Alaska cruise?
faqs.answer: For many travelers, yes. A veranda provides private outdoor space for viewing glaciers, mountains, wildlife and scenic waterways.

faqs.question: Does Celebrity offer Alaska Cruisetours?
faqs.answer: Yes. Celebrity Cruisetours combine a seven-night Alaska cruise with a multi-night land tour, with selected itineraries including Denali, Anchorage and Talkeetna.

faqs.question: Can I visit Denali on a Celebrity Alaska vacation?
faqs.answer: Yes. Selected Celebrity Cruisetours combine Alaska cruises with Denali and other inland destinations.

faqs.question: Is Vancouver or Seattle better for a Celebrity Alaska cruise?
faqs.answer: Both can be good options. Vancouver offers a wide range of Alaska itineraries, while selected Celebrity Dawes Glacier cruises operate round trip from Seattle.

faqs.question: What wildlife can I see on a Celebrity Alaska cruise?
faqs.answer: Travelers may encounter humpback whales, orcas, bald eagles, bears, seals, sea otters and other Alaska wildlife depending on the itinerary and excursions.

faqs.question: Are Celebrity Alaska Cruises worth it?
faqs.answer: They can be an excellent choice for travelers who want to combine Alaska's glaciers, wildlife and Inside Passage scenery with a premium cruise experience and the option to add an Alaska land tour.
